mapper.select:
SELECT g.id, g.user_id AS userId, g.name, g.phone_num AS phoneNum, g.description, g.address, g.address_detail AS addressDetail, g.postcode, g.latitude, g.longitude, g.file, g.facility, g.background_img AS backgroundImg, g.br_file AS brFile,
u.email_id AS emailId, u.name AS userName, u.tel, u.profileImg AS profileImg FROM gym g JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.id WHERE g.id = #{gymId}
mapper.update: UPDATE gym SET name = #{name}, phone_num = #{phoneNum}, description = #{description}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, postcode = #{postcode}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, facility = #{facility}, file = #{file}, background_img = #{backgroundImg}, br_file = #{brFile} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET email_id = #{emailId}, name = #{userName}, tel = #{tel}, profileImg = #{profileImg} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT gs_num AS gsNum, gym_num AS gymNum, available_weekday_start AS availableWeekdayStart, available_weekday_end AS availableWeekdayEnd, available_weekend_start AS availableWeekendStart, available_weekend_end AS availableWeekendEnd FROM gym_schedule WHERE gym_num = #{gymId}
mapper.update: UPDATE gym_schedule SET available_weekday_start = #{availableWeekdayStart}, available_weekday_end = #{availableWeekdayEnd}, available_weekend_start = #{availableWeekendStart}, available_weekend_end = #{availableWeekendEnd} WHERE gym_num = #{gymNum}
mapper.select: SELECT membership_num AS membershipNum, gym_num AS gymNum, type, type_rep AS typeRep, price FROM membership WHERE gym_num = #{gymId} ORDER BY membership_num
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership ( gym_num, type, type_rep, price ) VALUES ( #{gymNum}, #{type}, #{typeRep}, #{price} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, gym_id AS gymId, day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime FROM gym_peak_time WHERE gym_id = #{gymId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gym_peak_time ( gym_id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time ) VALUES ( #{gymId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{startTime}, #{endTime} )
